main_text.p: nem lapidarii [?] vel ad annum [?] ... Adriano, ... Rabbi ... Meilia ... agnovit, deceptus ... um mendacii ... niticatus anno CXX ... tormis, filius Clo... Benzaccai, qui cum R. Gamaliele ... fi, lun... de veterem ... per duodecennium ... liquæ & aqua ... bat, ad collumnia ... debat, tempore ... Scriptis ... ut sitiens extaret, a Carmelo ... Thalmud fabulatur. Tum ... ob vanitatem ... Judaismum recepit, & Vetus Testamentum ... Græcam linguam ... MO ... puerum inter Deos ... templum ... inlisuit, &c.
main_text.head: CAPUT III. DE ANTONINO PIO.
main_text.p: Anni fere 22. mens. 7. dies 20. ad A. C. 162.
main_text.note: R. Abraham Levi cit. Schickardo in Tarich p. 97.

page.notes: Much of the page is faded and damaged; the marginal notes and the heading block are only partly legible, so many words are uncertain and the transcription of the text block is approximate. The bottom right shows a faint printed page fragment and is not transcribed.
